subject: MAP draft — POC env dependency playbook & owners
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft — POC env dependency playbook & owners

Hi Sam,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion I put together a short dependency playbook for the MAP milestone (POC environment setup). Please review and confirm owners / target dates so we can lock the MAP:

1) VPC peering
- What we need from you: VPC ID, CIDR, and account ID for peering
- What we'll provide: Redwood's peer VPC ID and peering request template
- Owner: GridLytics network team (please confirm name)
- Target: requested by 2026-07-25

2) IP allowlists / egress
- What we need from you: single list of allowed IPs/CIDRs to whitelist for control plane and egress
- Redwood can provide static egress IPs; confirm if you need per-region ranges
- Target: provide allowlist by 2026-07-22

3) SSO / SAML
- We support SAML 2.0 and will need IdP metadata or metadata URL, plus an SSO test user
- Owner: GridLytics identity team
- Target: metadata & test user by 2026-07-24

4) Secrets / KMS
- If you want customer-managed keys, we require AWS Key ARN + IAM role to allow encrypt/decrypt
- Otherwise Redwood can manage keys; please indicate preference
- Target: decision by 2026-07-23

Blockers: network ACLs and lack of test service account credentials.

Attachments: redwood_map_template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_preflight_checklist.pdf (docs)

Next steps: can you confirm owners for each line and the dates above by EOD 2026-07-19? I'll update the MAP and circulate.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
From: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@gridlytics.com>

Cc: Ayesha Kapoor <ayesha.kapoor@gridlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — POC env dependency playbook & owners

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear list. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- VPC peering: owner is Ayesha Kapoor (Network Lead). She'll own the peering request and validation. We can target completing the peering by 2026-07-25. I've attached our internal PEERING_REQUEST.docx for your template needs.

- IP allowlists: we prefer a single allowlist. If Redwood can provide static egress IPs as CIDR ranges that's fine. We will need the list in CIDR format (not single IPs) and a note about which ports/protocols are required. We'll aim to deliver our allowlist (ingress rules) by 2026-07-22.

- SSO/SAML: our identity team will provide IdP metadata. Ayesha will loop in our IdP owner (she's copied). Expect metadata + a test user by 2026-07-24.

- KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys. I'll confirm the AWS account ID and intended key ARN by 2026-07-23, but we may need Redwood to outline the minimal IAM role actions required.

Blockers noted: we will prioritize the test service account credentials, but that will come after peering is scheduled.

Sam
Director, Infrastructure
GridLytics
sam.irwin@gridlytics.com

Subject: Re: MAP draft — POC env dependency playbook & owners

Adding a few technical clarifications from the infra team to avoid rework: 

- Egress IPs / CIDRs: Redwood can provide stable egress CIDR ranges. For this POC we suggest you whitelist the following ranges (used by our control plane):
  - 35.227.128.0/20
  - 34.72.0.0/16
  - 52.15.0.0/18
Please confirm you can accept those ranges; if you need single IPs we can provide NATed addresses but that lengthens setup.

- Ports/protocols: allow outbound TCP 443 and 5246 (for control hooks).

- SAML / SSO: we act as the Service Provider (SP); we need either IdP metadata XML or a metadata URL. Additionally, please provide an SSO test user and include an attribute mapping for email and groups if you plan to gate access by group.

- KMS / secrets: we support customer-managed keys. Required info from GridLytics: AWS account ID and Key ARN. We will give you a minimal IAM policy snippet for the role we ask you to create (Encrypt/Decrypt permissions scoped to the key). I attached a short note with the KMS integration steps.

- Test credentials: to validate secret retrieval and SSO flows we need a service principal with read access to the test key or a temporary access token.

I'll mark the following as gates in the MAP: peering established, allowlist applied, SSO metadata received, test credentials available. If any gate slips we'll push the POC walkthrough by equivalent days.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
